plans.title: Plans
plans.home.coming: Only owners and managers save plans; you can still read the plans of your stores.
plans.home.packHint: Build the pack on Export data, then give it with the prompt to your own assistant.
plans.home.pasteHint: Paste the assistant's answer to check it against its own data pack and get the list of problems to send back.
plans.paste.title: Paste a plan
plans.paste.intro: Paste the assistant's whole answer below, then press “Check”. The plan is checked against the exact data pack its front matter names, on this device.
plans.paste.noPack: Not given a data pack to the assistant yet?
plans.paste.label: The assistant's plan
plans.paste.hint: Include the front matter: the JSON between the two --- lines.
plans.paste.empty: Paste a plan before checking it.
plans.paste.saveLater: Only an owner or a manager can save a plan.
plans.paste.saveFirst: Check the plan before saving it.
plans.paste.saveBlocked: Fix the errors and check again before saving. Warnings do not block saving.
plans.pack.missing: The data pack {pack} is not on this device. The plan was written from that pack: attach the pack file (.json) you downloaded when you built it.
plans.pack.noId: The plan's front matter names no data pack, so it is not known which pack to check against. Attach the data pack you gave the assistant.
plans.pack.noBuild: The app does not build a new pack instead: the figures of past days can change after a later sync.
plans.pack.refused: This file is not a valid data pack, so it was not used. Choose the file downloaded with “Download the AI data pack”.
plans.pack.used: Checked against pack {pack}, with data up to {date}.
plans.pack.sample: This is the demo's sample pack: the check is the same, but a plan written from a sample pack is never saved.
plans.pack.other: The plan names pack {plan}, and the attached file is pack {pack}.
plans.result.title: Check result
plans.result.valid: The plan is valid. Sections: {sections}; initiatives: {initiatives}; correct citations: {citations}; KPIs: {kpis}.
plans.result.invalid: The plan is not valid yet. Errors: {errors}; warnings: {warnings}.
plans.result.warnings: Warnings left: {warnings}. Warnings do not block saving.
plans.result.lineNote: Line numbers count in the checked text at the end of the page: text before the front matter and a fence around the plan were removed.
plans.result.copied: List copied. Paste it into the chat so the assistant fixes the plan.
plans.result.copyManual: The browser does not allow copying automatically. Copy from the box below.
plans.result.copyBox: The list of problems to send back to the assistant
plans.result.text: The checked text, with line numbers
plans.copy.heading: Result of checking the plan against data pack {pack}. Errors: {errors}; warnings: {warnings}. Please fix them and send the whole plan again.
plans.lint.front_matter_missing: The plan does not start with its front matter (a JSON object between two --- lines), or the front matter is never closed.
plans.lint.front_matter_invalid: The front matter is not a valid fnb-plan/1 JSON object; the detail names the failing key.
plans.lint.content_too_large: The plan is longer than 200,000 bytes.
plans.lint.pack_mismatch: The pack in the front matter is not this data pack's id: it must be the pack_id of the pack the plan was written from.
plans.lint.horizon_mismatch: The horizon in the front matter is not the data pack's.
plans.lint.initiatives_count: Initiatives in the plan: {count}; a plan needs 5 to 7.
plans.lint.initiative_number: Initiatives are numbered 1, 2, 3… without gaps; initiative {number} is out of place.
plans.lint.initiative_field_missing: Initiative {number} lacks the field “{field}”, or the field is empty.
plans.lint.initiative_uncited: Initiative {number} cites no number of the data pack correctly.
plans.lint.citation_unknown: The citation [[{ref}]] names no cell of the data pack; the context is never cited.
plans.lint.citation_mismatch: The number written before the citation [[{ref}]] does not match the cited cell.
plans.lint.kpis_count: KPIs in the front matter: {count}; a plan needs 1 to 8.
plans.lint.kpi_unknown: The KPI “{id}” is not in the metric registry.
plans.lint.kpi_untracked: The KPI “{id}” is a metric the app cannot track as a KPI.
plans.lint.kpi_scope_unknown: The KPI “{id}” names a store the data pack does not hold.
plans.lint.kpi_unmeasured: The data pack has no value for the last four weeks (w28) of the KPI “{id}” in the scope written.
plans.lint.kpi_baseline_mismatch: The baseline written for the KPI “{id}” is not the data pack's w28 value.
plans.lint.kpi_target_unchanged: The target of the KPI “{id}” equals its current value.
plans.lint.kpi_initiative_unknown: The KPI “{id}” is linked to an initiative the plan does not have.
plans.lint.kpi_initiative_unlinked: An initiative linked to the KPI “{id}” does not mention it in its KPI field.
plans.lint.preamble_text: Text stood before the plan's front matter; it was left out.
plans.lint.front_matter_extra_fields: The front matter has keys that are not used; they were left out and the plan stays valid.
plans.lint.uncited_numbers: Numbers without a citation in sections 1 and 2 or in an Evidence field: {count}.
plans.paste.scopeDenied: You may not save a plan for every store of this plan.
plans.paste.rejected: The database refused the plan. Codes: {codes}
plans.paste.rateLimited: More than 20 plans were saved in 24 hours. Try again later.
plans.paste.saveFailed: The plan could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
plans.paste.samplePack: A plan written from a sample pack is never sent to be saved.
plans.paste.demoNote: In the demo, saved plans stay in this browser until the tab is closed.
plans.list.intro: Each group is one set of stores; the newest plan comes first.
plans.list.pack: Build the data pack for AI
plans.list.failed: The plans could not be loaded.
plans.list.followUpFailed: The KPIs could not be measured.
plans.list.empty: No plan yet. There are three ways to run the strategy, all with one data pack and one prompt: chat with an assistant on any device and paste the plan here; a personal command on the owner's computer; or a monthly scheduled run.
plans.detail.notFound: This plan was not found, or you may not read it.
plans.detail.packHint: The pack id only proves the stored pack was not altered. The re-measured baselines are what check the plan against the database.
plans.detail.lintNote: Checked again against the stored pack: {errors} errors, {warnings} warnings.
plans.detail.citeMissing: The citation {ref} points to no cell of the data pack.
plans.detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this plan for good? This cannot be undone.
plans.detail.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
plans.compare.title: Compare two plans
plans.compare.noPartner: There is no other plan to compare with.
plans.compare.unreadable: One of the two plans cannot be read: it may have been deleted, or you may not read it.
plans.compare.header: Created {created}, data up to {asOf}, horizon {horizon}, prompt {prompt}, pack {pack}, {initiatives} initiatives
